== Rules ==
* Map order: 
- All matches are Best of 5 (BO5). Grand Finals are Best of 5 (BO5) with a bracket reset in the case that the team from the loser's side wins the first BO5.

Use /cmd rnd to decide who picks first (Team 1).

Pick order: The order for Bo5 is T1 pick → T2 pick → T1 toss → T2 toss → Losing pick → Other pick → decider.

“Losing team” means the one trailing in total maps (e.g., 0–2 or 1–2), or if tied (1–1 or 2–2), the one who lost the previous map. A map cannot be played twice.

* Scheduling: '''IMPORTANT!''' In order to get this tournament completed in a timely manner play your match within a week of it's posting. If your opponents are unable to schedule within a week you must reach out to Bance with a time that you will be playing within 2 days of the end of week or a walkover will be awarded.
* Settings: Standard settings by typing "/2on2" | To add match tag type "/2on2 NAQL 2on2"
* Pause rules: Each player is allowed one pause per match, once you have used a pause and use it again, you have forfeited the map.
* Ping rules: Games will be played on NA servers unless both teams are outside of NA and wish to agree on another option. Find a server that keeps all players around the same ping, if no such server can be found, the lowest ping players will have to use cl_delay_packet to get closer to the higher ping players. If there's a dispute in what server should be used, contact admin on discord. For teams/players outside of NA you can request your best server in NA but cannot expect opponents to ping up beyond 50ms. '''50ms is the highest ping a player can be expected to ping up to regardless of where the player's are from after selecting the best NA server.'''
* Client: ezquake 3.6.x. or unezquake 1.3.x. For your own sake, update your client!
** Remember to check with f_version
* Reporting: send screenshots in #naql-2on2 on the discord.
* cl_idrive is NOT allowed, turn off your hardware SOCD functions if you have them.
